common.unknownArtist: Shown in place of an artist name when YouTube Music gives none.
common.untitled: Shown in place of an album or track title when YouTube Music gives none.
common.error: Title of an error box, and the message when the server gives no reason.
common.confirm: Default confirm button of a confirmation dialog.
common.save: Button saving the lyrics editor or a playlist's options.
common.delete: Confirm button of the delete artist and delete album dialogs. It deletes the files from disk.
common.close: Button (or the screen reader label of an ✕) closing a dialog or a panel.
common.clear: Tooltip of the ✕ inside a search box: empties the search text.
common.back: Button with a left arrow returning to the previous page: 'go back', not the body part.
common.or: Small word dividing two alternatives: the sign-in form and the single sign-on button, or the Browse search box and the playlist import button.
common.all: First tab on Browse and Library, showing every kind of result (artists, albums, tracks).
mediaCard.type: Small label under a card's title: the kind of release.
mediaCard.status: Badge on the cover of an album or artist card: its download state. Two words at most.
mediaCard.status.downloaded: Every track is downloaded: the audio files are on the server's disk.
mediaCard.status.inLibrary: In the library, but not every track is downloaded yet.
mediaCard.status.paused: Downloads are paused because YouTube rate-limited the server. They resume on their own.
auth.login.title: Heading of the sign-in page.
auth.login.loading: The sign-in button's label while it works.
auth.login.noAccount: Followed on the same line by the link auth.login.register.
auth.login.register: Link to the registration page, after auth.login.noAccount.
auth.login.sso: Single sign-on button. {name} is the sign-in provider's name, set by the admin (Authentik, Google...).
auth.register.loading: The create-account button's label while it works.
auth.register.hasAccount: Followed on the same line by the link auth.register.login.
auth.register.login: Link to the sign-in page, after auth.register.hasAccount.
auth.logout: User menu item that signs out.
auth.errors.tooManyAttempts: {minutes} is a whole number of minutes.
nav.browse: Navigation tab and page title: searching YouTube Music for new music. Other texts name this page ('the Browse search bar'): use the same word there.
nav.library: Navigation tab and page title: everything followed or downloaded. Other texts name this page.
nav.charts: Navigation tab: the weekly YouTube Music charts of each country. French keeps the English word 'chart'; use the word YouTube Music itself uses in your language.
nav.admin: User menu item opening the admin pages. Other texts name it ('The admin panel is in your account menu', 'Admin panel > Charts').
nav.main: Screen reader label of the navigation bar.
nav.activeJobs: Badge in the top bar counting the background jobs (downloads, syncs) running. Very short.
nav.rateLimited: Tooltip of a red badge in the top bar. {time} is a time of day, already formatted.
nav.jobTypes: Rows of the popover under nav.activeJobs: the kind of job, with its count in a separate column. Plural nouns, no number in the text.
settings.theme: Theme buttons: light or dark colors.
settings.accent.colors: Tooltip of each accent color swatch: a color name. A close one is fine (French says 'Framboise', raspberry, for rose).
home.welcomeBack: Home page title. {name} is the user's username.
home.inProgress: Section heading on Home: the albums downloading now.
browse.sections: Headings of the search result sections, and tab labels. The tab gets a count added after it: 'Artists (3)'.
browse.recommendations.similarTo: {names} is one or two artist names, already joined in your language ('A and B').
browse.recommendations.dismiss: Tooltip of the ✕ on a recommended artist: hides it from this user's recommendations.
browse.recommendations.dismissArtist: Screen reader label of that ✕. {name} is the artist.
browse.recommendations.undo: Button in the message shown after hiding an artist: brings it back.
browse.recommendations.dismissedLink: Link opening the list of hidden artists. {count} is how many there are.
browse.recommendations.restore: Button in the list of hidden artists: recommends that artist again.
artist.follow: Button on an artist: follow it, which downloads all its releases and watches for new ones. Not a social media follow.
artist.unfollow: Same button once followed: stop following. Files stay.
artist.followed: Tooltip of the follow button once the artist is followed: a state, not an action.
artist.like: Tooltip of the heart button: like the artist. Personal, it feeds the recommendations, and is not the same as follow.
artist.unlike: Same button once liked: remove the like.
artist.albums: Section heading on an artist page.
artist.singles: Section heading on an artist page.
artist.channelTitle: Heading on a page that is a YouTube channel (someone who uploads videos), not a music artist.
artist.chartFollow: {charts} is a list of country names, already joined ('France and Spain'). 'Admin panel > Charts' names nav.admin and admin.tabs.charts: use your translations of those.
album.album: Column header of a playlist's track list: the track's album.
album.downloadError: Tooltip of a failed track's badge. {error} is the technical error from YouTube or the downloader, in English.
album.download: Button on an album page: download just this album. Other texts name this button ('Download album on its page').
album.following: The album.download button once the album is in the library: a disabled state, not an action.
album.title: Column header of a track list: the track's title.
album.status: Column header: each track's download state.
album.lyrics: Column header: each track's lyrics state. Other texts name this column ('the Lyrics column').
album.trackStatus: Badges in the Status column of an album's track list. Short.
album.trackStatus.removed: YouTube Music took the track down.
album.retryingAfter: {error} is a technical error from YouTube or the downloader, in English.
album.pausedUntil: {time} is a time of day, already formatted.
lyrics.kind: Badges in the Lyrics column, also explained one by one in the quick tour (onboarding.lyrics.kinds). One word if possible. 'Lyrics' is plural in French, so 'Synchronisées' agrees with it.
lyrics.kind.synced: Lyrics with timestamps, whose lines show in time with the music (LRC).
lyrics.formatHint: [mm:ss.xx] is literal LRC syntax: keep it as it is.
library.searchPlaceholder: Placeholder of the library search box, which searches artist names, album titles and track titles.
library.view: Tooltips of the grid and list layout toggle.
library.columns: Column headers of the library's list view. Short: the columns are narrow.
library.columns.added: Header of the date column for albums: when the album was added.
library.columns.followed: Header of the date column for artists: when the artist was followed (French: 'Suivi depuis', followed since).
library.meta.trackCount: {tracks} is downloaded/total, like '3/10', so no plural form applies.
library.trackMatch: Line under an artist or album that matched the search through one of its tracks. {title} is that track's title, {album} the album it's on.
library.stats: Labels of the four stat cards on Home and Library.
library.stats.diskUsageShort: library.stats.diskUsage on narrow phones: one short word.
library.filters.buttonActive: Screen reader label of the Filters button while {count} filters are on.
library.filters.remove: Screen reader label of the ✕ on an active filter. {label} is the filter's label.
library.filters.results: {formatted} is the count with thousand separators: put {formatted} in the text. The plural form is picked from the count.
library.filters.showResults: Button closing the filter panel on phones. {formatted} is the count with thousand separators; the plural form is picked from the count.
library.filters.groups: Headings of the groups in the filter panel.
library.filters.groups.source: What brought an album into the library: one of library.filters.options.source.
library.filters.options.source.own: The album was downloaded by itself, not through its artist or a playlist.
library.filters.groups.follow: How the artist is followed: one of library.filters.options.follow.
library.filters.options.follow.full: Followed: all its releases downloaded, new ones watched for.
library.filters.options.follow.light: In the library only for some albums (downloaded one by one, or kept after unfollowing). New releases aren't downloaded.
library.filters.options.follow.chart: Followed automatically because it's in a followed chart.
library.filters.groups.excluded: Artists and albums deleted or unfollowed by hand, which charts and playlists won't bring back.
library.filters.hints: Shown under a result while its filter is on, joined with ' · ': says why it matches.
library.sort.button: Screen reader label of the sort button. {key} is a library.sort.keys label, {order} a library.sort.order label.
library.sort.keys.completion: Sorting by how much of each album or artist is downloaded.
library.sort.order: Options of the order switch, for each sort key.
library.excluded.restore: Screen reader label of a restore button. {name} is an artist or album.
charts.followingTopN: {n} is how many top artists are followed, {total} how many the chart has.
charts.lastUpdated: {date} is a date and time, already formatted.
charts.musicChart: Small line under the country name in the follow chart dialog.
charts.top: Small label before the chosen number of top artists to follow: 'Top 10'.
charts.keepWeeks.column: Column header in the admin charts table. The values are charts.keepWeeks.never or charts.keepWeeks.weeks.
charts.keepWeeks.weeks: Dropdown option. 'Out of the chart': the time since the artist left the chart.
admin.tabs: Tabs of the admin panel. Other texts name them ('Admin panel > Charts').
admin.settings.default: Button next to a changed setting that resets it to its default value: a verb (reset), not the noun 'default'.
admin.settings.resetToDefault: Tooltip of that button. {value} is the default value: a number, admin.settings.on or off, or an option's label.
admin.settings.on: A yes/no setting's value, shown inside admin.settings.resetToDefault.
admin.settings.off: A yes/no setting's value, shown inside admin.settings.resetToDefault.
admin.settings.categories: Section headings of the settings page.
admin.settings.keys: Each setting's label, and the description under it. A unit in the label, like '(minutes)', is the unit of its number field.
admin.settings.cookies.present: {count} is how many cookies the file holds, {date} when it was uploaded (already formatted).
admin.settings.schedule: The schedule input: a dropdown (modeInterval_* or modeFixed), then a number and a unit, or a time and the weekday buttons.
admin.settings.schedule.modeInterval_hou: Dropdown option, followed on screen by a number field and admin.settings.schedule.unit_hours: 'Every [6] hours'. It gets {count}: add plural variants if 'every' agrees with the number in your language.
admin.settings.schedule.modeInterval_day: Dropdown option, followed on screen by a number field and admin.settings.schedule.unit_days: 'Every [7] days'. It gets {count}: add plural variants if 'every' agrees with the number in your language.
admin.settings.schedule.modeFixed: Dropdown option, followed by a time field and the weekday buttons: 'At [04:00]'.
admin.settings.schedule.unit_hours: Word after the number field ('Every [6] hours'), and the field's screen reader label. Narrow: about 7 characters fit.
admin.settings.schedule.unit_days: Word after the number field ('Every [7] days'), and the field's screen reader label. Narrow: about 7 characters fit.
admin.settings.schedule.fixedSummary: {days} is a list of short weekday names, already joined, or admin.settings.schedule.everyDay. {time} is a 24-hour time like 04:00.
admin.settings.schedule.nextRun: {when} is a date and time, already formatted.
admin.settings.schedule.timezone: {timezone} is a time zone name like Europe/Paris. TZ is an environment variable: keep it.
admin.users.active: A user account's state, and a filter option: the account can sign in.
admin.users.ssoBadge: Small badge on users who sign in with single sign-on. Keep 'SSO' unless your language has a usual short form.
admin.users.roles: Role names. Visitor: read only. Member: can add music. Administrator: everything.
admin.users.temporaryPasswordDone: Button closing the temporary password dialog.
admin.charts.previewTop: {n} is the largest number of top artists a chart can follow.
admin.charts.topArtists: Column header, and the screen reader label of the number field in that column: how many of the chart's top artists are followed.
admin.charts.hidePreview: Toggle closing the preview that admin.charts.preview opened.
admin.charts.neverSynced: Value of the 'Last synced' column for a chart never synced.
admin.charts.confirm: {country} is a country name. {n}, {from} and {to} are numbers of top artists.
admin.backup.sections: Lowercase: shown in parentheses after the chosen file's name, as a list ('backup.json (library, users and settings)').
admin.backup.export.options: Toggles choosing what goes into the backup.
admin.backup.summary: Row labels of the import preview table. The value (a number or a list of names) is in the next column.
playlist.untitled: Title of a playlist that has no name.
playlist.artists: Tab label, with a count added after it: 'Artists (3)'.
playlist.albums: Tab label, with a count added after it: 'Albums (3)'.
playlist.trackView: Tab listing the playlist's tracks, with a count added after it: 'Tracks (12)'.
playlist.mainArtist: Badge on an artist credited first on at least one of the playlist's songs: the ones 'Follow main artists' follows.
playlist.secondaryArtist: Badge on an artist only credited as featured.
playlist.followed: An artist row's follow button once the artist is followed: a state.
playlist.downloaded: An album row's download button once its download is queued: a state.
playlist.followingProgress: {current} of the {total} artists are done so far.
playlist.downloadingProgress: {current} of the {total} albums are done so far.
playlist.skippedUploads: Uploads: videos people posted on YouTube, not songs released by an artist.
playlist.options.bringIn: Heading of a choice between playlist.options.albums and playlist.options.artists: what the playlist's songs add to the library.
playlist.options.albums: Choice: each song brings in its whole album. 'Their' means the songs'.
playlist.options.artists: Choice: each song brings in its main artist, followed. 'Their' means the songs'.
playlist.options.follow: Toggle: keep watching the playlist for new songs.
playlist.options.add: Confirm button of the add playlist dialog.
playlist.options.editButton: Button opening a playlist's options dialog.
playlist.status.followed: Badge on a saved playlist: watched for new songs (feminine in French: la playlist).
playlist.status.once: Badge on a saved playlist: added once, not watched.
playlist.status.available: {available} of the playlist's {songs} songs are in the library.
playlist.status.lastScan: {when} is a date and time, already formatted.
playlist.status.lastError: {error} is a technical error from YouTube, in English.
onboarding: The quick tour shown at first sign-in.
onboarding.step: Step counter in the tour's corner: '2 / 7'.
onboarding.previous: Button to the previous step of the tour, next to onboarding.next.
onboarding.finish: Button closing the tour on its last step.
onboarding.follow.body: 'Download album' names the button album.download: use your translation of it.
onboarding.lyrics.kinds: Explanations shown after each lyrics.kind badge, starting lowercase: '[Synced] lines light up in time with the music'.
onboarding.admin.tabs: One-line description next to each admin.tabs tab.
onboarding.done: Descriptions under the page names in the tour's last step.
exclusion.badge: Badge on an artist or album deleted or unfollowed by hand, which charts and playlists won't bring back.
